name: ForeignControls.html-index
why: Foreign web UI answering /v1/models with a 200 text/html index page must stay FOREIGN_SERVICE html-non-model (ishtml via Content-Type, kama-probe.sh:506-511).

name: ForeignControls.openmetrics-text
why: 200 application/openmetrics-text exposition has no JSON content type and no model array, so it is FOREIGN_SERVICE non-model-2xx (kama-probe.sh:514-519) — status-only liveness must not pass.

/v1/models.body_text:
# HELP kama_up Service reachability
# TYPE kama_up gauge
kama_up 1
# EOF

name: ForeignControls.json-no-model-array
why: 200 application/json object without a data[] or models[] list is FOREIGN_SERVICE schema-unrecognized (body_has_model_array kama-probe.sh:392-411, reason at 516).

name: ForeignControls.json-data-object-not-array
why: 200 JSON whose data key is an object, not an array, still fails body_has_model_array (requires isinstance list, kama-probe.sh:403-405) -> schema-unrecognized; guards a naive key-presence check.

name: ForeignControls.not-found-json
why: 404 JSON error body is a non-2xx HTTP answer from a non-model service -> FOREIGN_SERVICE non-2xx-non-model-http (kama-probe.sh:520-522).

name: ForeignControls.server-error-json
why: 500 JSON error object whose type is server_error, not the exact llama.cpp loading shape, stays FOREIGN_SERVICE non-2xx-non-model-http; C1 may only match message+type+code exactly.

name: ForeignControls.code-integer-500
why: 503 whose error has the exact message and type but integer code 500: the rule needs code == 503, so an any-integer-code matcher would wrongly grade it MODEL_LOADING (falsify-wave ReviewQualityKq19; replaces a duplicate of Overbroad503.no-slot-available).

name: ForeignControls.html-body-sniff-text-plain
why: 200 HTML page served as text/plain: only the body sniff (<!doctype ... html) marks it HTML, so this row pins that sniff, which no Content-Type text/html row exercises (falsify-wave FamilyForeignControls F4; replaces a duplicate of Overbroad503.server-error-type).
